title: Security
subject: gated-scoped-ac
summary: What the library guarantees, what it trusts the app to get right, and what a rule does when a value it reads is absent.

axioms.text: The library trusts every value in the bag and every permission it is handed. Building them from server-side sources is the app's job.
Default deny: a [[scope]] no rule contributed to matches no rows, and a create no rule allows is refused.
A query that skips access control does not compile: the gate requires a scope, and only the engine mints one.

purpose.intro: Where the library's responsibility starts and stops, what it guarantees inside that line, and what a rule does when a value it reads is absent.

reference.statement: The library starts when the [[access context]] is in hand and ends when the gate's query returns. Everything before that is the app's.

claims.text: The library authenticates no one and verifies no session (AC39 in [[access-control|Access Control]]).
The active organization and the membership roles must come from the server's own resolution of the caller's memberships, never from a header or a body taken as is.
A create is judged on the row that lands: the gate sets `$requestBody` to the values it inserts, replacing anything a caller put there.

reference.statement: Inside the boundary, these hold whatever the config says.

claims.text: **Default deny.** No applicable rule compiles to `false`; a create with no applicable rule is refused. A permission with no rules applies to nothing.
**The brand.** `read`, `update` and `delete` require a `Scope` of the same entity and action. Any other scope, or none, is a compile error, checked by `test/types.test-d.ts`.
**Narrow only.** The read builder ANDs every `where` onto the scope, and nothing on it can OR.

**No silent grants in config.** A traversal beside other conditions, a payload the engine would ignore, and `is` against a collection column are refused at boot rather than compiled into something broader than they read.

**Absent values never grant.** A path that is unset or null fails every condition that reads it, under every operator and in every slot (below). A payload traversal whose value is missing refuses the create; it never becomes a check every parent row would pass.
**Values are parameters.** Operands are bound by drizzle. Column names come only from config, and the engine accepts only columns of the tables it was given.

reference.statement: The engine keeps no list of valid paths. A path that is not set, or set to null, such as `$session.organization.type` when no organization is active, is absent, and a condition reading an absent value fails, whatever its operator.

claims.text: In a context or a direct payload condition both sides come from the bag, so either side absent fails: two missing paths are not equal, and a negation never passes on a value that is not there.
In a target, an absent operand drops the whole rule: it adds no rows, and lends no columns to the field-list union.
A NULL column is row data, not an absent path. With a present operand, `isNot` and `hasNot` still match rows whose column is NULL.
So "the org type is not X" fails for a caller with no organization at all. A rule that must also admit that caller cannot be written as a negation.
A rule naming a path hydration never writes loads without complaint and then never matches. The bag's paths are listed in [[gated-scoped-ac-bag|Access context]].

imagesAndDiagrams.title: When the path is absent
imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Slot | `is`, `has` | `isNot` | `hasNot` |
|---|---|---|---|
| context (either side) | the rule is dropped | the rule is dropped | the rule is dropped |
| target (the operand) | the rule matches no row and lends no columns | the same | the same |
| payload, a direct condition (either side) | denies | denies | denies |
| payload, a traversal (its subject, or an operand in its `where`) | denies | denies | denies |

reference.statement: Each of these reaches the library as a valid request, so it has to be stopped before it or around it.

imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Risk | Where it is stopped |
|---|---|
| a bag built from client-supplied values | hydration builds it from the verified session and server-side memberships |
| a caller holding a role they should not | the writes that assign roles are themselves gated |
| `ungated()` used on a path a route reaches | review: every use is a named exception in its repository |
| a public route returning private data | the `Public` and `Private` tokens, checked by the compiler |
| sight of a row through a share or a link | a rule or a visibility channel (`visibilityJoins`) that grants it, never an ad hoc query |

reference.statement: Denials are values; only mistakes throw.

claims.text: A denial is never an exception: the gate returns `null` or no rows, and the verdicts return `{ allow: false, reason }`.
The engine throws only on programming errors (an unknown entity or column, a condition with no operator), which surface as a 500 rather than as access.
